races.paceDynamic: Snowrocco will take them along at a sustainable gallop with no other confirmed front runners to pressure him early. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Tamarind Bay, Jehol De Thaix, Nosy Neighbour, Tea Boy) will create a bunched field behind the early pace, setting up a sprint finish where positioning and timing will be crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Snowrocco gets an easy lead and kicks clear before theClosers can get to him
scenarios.body: His recent wins show he's effective when allowed to dictate, and the soft ground suits his style perfectly. The hold-up brigade may leave their runs too late on this testing surface.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Closers Time It Right
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get the perfect pace setup and strong finishing kick
scenarios.body: Tamarind Bay has the highest rating and consistent soft ground form, while the sustained gallop will suit the patient tactics. Jehol De Thaix could emerge as the main danger with his solid recent second.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Chemoulin and Milan Park track Snowrocco closely and pounce when he tires
scenarios.body: These two can sit handy without doing the donkey work, perfectly positioned to strike in the straight. Their prominent styles avoid the traffic issues that could hamper the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the outsiders benefits from a perfectly run race and chaos ahead
scenarios.body: The pace collapse or interference could open the door for a horse like Nosy Neighbour to sneak up the rail. Tea Boy might find significant improvement dropping down the handicap ladder.

watchPoints.text: Snowrocco must be watched for how easily he gets to the front - if uncontested he becomes very dangerous
Tamarind Bay needs checking for market support given his class advantage but tactical disadvantage
The gap between prominent runners (Chemoulin, Milan Park, Dramatic License) and Snowrocco will determine if he gets an easy lead
Jehol De Thaix showed improved form last time and could be overpriced given his hold-up style suits the pace scenario
Ground conditions on the day could favor the hold-up horses if it rides slower than advertised

races.paceDynamic: Cahier's Den will set the early gallop in what shapes as a steadily-run contest, with no obvious pace pressure from the six hold-up horses behind. The strong pace angle creates a tactical race where Sir Carnegie, Rosa Diaz and Florita will need to time their moves perfectly from the rear, while Cahier's Den gets an uncontested lead that could prove decisive over this stamina-sapping trip on testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Cahier's Den gets an easy lead and stays galloping
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the front-runner to dictate fractions and kick clear approaching the final fence. The hold-up horses struggle to reel in the leader who has conserved energy throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Times It
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian early on
scenarios.body: Sir Carnegie's proven ability on similar ground allows him to produce a sustained finish that catches the tiring leader. His recent Soft ground victory gives him the edge over rivals who lack that form credential.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improving Form Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Florita reproduces her recent winning form
scenarios.body: The mare's two victories from last five starts on Soft ground sees her bridge the gap between the leaders and stragglers perfectly. Her tactical speed allows her to be closer than usual and outkick the front-runner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Cahier's Den stops quickly after setting slow fractions
scenarios.body: The pedestrian gallop becomes a sprint finish where any of the hold-up horses can win if producing their best. Rosa Diaz's higher rating could tell in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Cahier's Den gets more than three lengths clear turning for home as no proven finisher may catch him
Monitor Sir Carnegie's position at the third-last fence as he needs to be within striking distance to use his proven finishing kick
Observe Florita's jumping rhythm early as her recent wins came with slick fencing that saved ground
Check if Rosa Diaz gets a clear run from two out as her hold-up style requires an unimpeded passage
Watch the overall gallop through the first mile as truly slow fractions will neutralize rating advantages

scenarios.trigger: If Roarin' Success gets an easy lead without pressure from the prominent runners
